note: Inputs for tools/design/map/history.py. The famous sites are fixed every game; the hidden slots are ground for the history (#27), which names each one and links it to a fact, and each game's seed picks one candidate per slot (Travel & Map rule 15). Counts follow rule 28 and Formula C's table; ΔD3 follows Formula B's targets (large 0.5-1.0, small 0.3-0.6, secret 0.1-0.3). Cycles follow rule 26.

names.note: Lục Du: thiết mã băng hà nhập mộng lai, armoured horses and frozen rivers come into my dreams. Its gate opens inside Chiết Kích Nguyên, near the barrow; whose war it holds is for the history (#27).
Sơn Hải Kinh: in the hot valley stands the Phù Tang tree, where the ten suns bathe. Its gate is on the island Dục Nhật Đảo, where the sun bathes.

names.gloss: Realm of the Peach Blossom Spring
names.note: Đào Uyên Minh: a fisherman follows a stream of peach petals through a cave into a hidden valley, and can never find it again. Its gate is a cave by a forest stream.

Tô Thức: cố lũy tây biên, nhân đạo thị Tam Quốc Chu lang Xích Bích, west of the old ramparts, they say, is where the Three Kingdoms fought. Fallen walls on the edge of Chiết Kích Nguyên; whose they were is for the history (#27).

names.gloss: Blessed Land of the North Star
names.note: Luận Ngữ: like the North Star, which keeps its place while all the stars turn toward it. Around Thiên Xu Tông's seat.

names.gloss: Blessed Land of the Thousand-Foot Pines
names.note: Đỗ Phủ: thanh tùng hận bất cao thiên xích, I only regret the green pine is not a thousand feet tall. Around Tùng Đào Cung's seat.

names.gloss: Blessed Land Where the Earth Is Alive
names.note: Vương Bột, Đằng Vương Các Tự (the text Lạc Hà is named from): nhân kiệt địa linh, great men where the earth is alive with spirit. Around Lạc Hà Tông's seat.
Tuyền cơ, the bowl of the Dipper and the armillary that tracks it. The sect head's retreat.
Vương Duy: minh nguyệt tùng gian chiếu, thanh tuyền thạch thượng lưu; the city Tùng Gian took the first half. The sect head's retreat.
Vương Bột: châu liêm mộ quyển Tây Sơn vũ, at dusk the pearl blinds roll up on the rain over the western hills. The sect head's retreat.
Where the rain the tower listens to turns to thunder. The sect head's retreat.
The ice heart in its jade pot, kept plain. The sect head's retreat.
Lý Bạch: thương thương hoành thúy vi, grey-green, the emerald haze lies across the hills. The sect head's retreat.
Đỗ Phủ: bích ngô thê lão phượng hoàng chi, on the green wutong the old phoenix perches. The sect head's retreat.

hidden.why: the grounds of a vanished sect
